editorial:
Sky Raiders is a Universal serial released April 8, 1941. It was directed by Ford Beebe and Ray Taylor and stars Donald Woods as Captain Bob Dayton, with Billy Halop, Robert Armstrong and Eduardo Ciannelli. Charles Previn is credited with the music. A creator might want it for the Billy Halop and Robert Armstrong casting.

The open question is the print. A 1941 film is free only if its copyright was never renewed in the 1968-1969 window. We identified the 1968 and 1969 Catalog of Copyright Entries volumes but did not read their renewal entries. We have not searched for a renewal, so we have no confirmed renewal and no confirmed absence of one. Universal's name on the film is not a trademark clearance either. Check the renewal records yourself before treating the print as free.
faq: Is Sky Raiders (1941) in the public domain?

Not confirmed. We have not searched for a renewal. The 1968 and 1969 renewal sections have not been read, so renewal status is unknown. Until you have checked, treat the film as possibly still protected.
Can I use the Internet Archive copy?

Hosting on archive.org does not show a film is free of copyright. The upload is a copy of Chapter 1 only. Your right to reuse it depends on the 1941 copyright's renewal status. Check that status first.
